name: Tom Brady New England Patriots Super Bowl LI Champions Autographed Super Bowl LI Pro Football with "SB LI MVP" Inscription
description: Celebrate a historic moment in Tom Brady's career by adding this Autographed Super Bowl LI Champions Pro Football with ''SB LI MVP'' Inscription to your memorabilia collection. Super Bowl LI was Brady's seventh Super Bowl appearance of his career and he had the chance to tie Charles Haley for the most Super Bowl wins by a single player with five. They were up against the high-powered offense of the Atlanta Falcons who went 11-5 in the regular season and had MVP-winning quarterback Matt Ryan at the helm, as well as First-Team All-Pro selection Julio Jones at wide receiver. Halfway through the third quarter, the Falcons increased their lead to 28-3 and it appeared as if the deficit would be insurmountable, but that is when Tom Brady and the Patriots stepped up to the challenge. After the incredible play on both sides of the ball for New England, they were able to tie the game up with less than a minute left in the 4th quarter to send the game to overtime. The Patriots got the ball first in OT and it took less than four minutes for them to drive 75 yards down the field and win the game on a James White two-yard touchdown run, meaning they overcame the largest deficit in Super Bowl history of 25 points. Only a player of Tom Brady's caliber would have been able to pull off such a miraculous comeback, so pay homage to one of his vintage performances with this eye-catching football.

name: Emilio Estevez The Mighty Ducks Autographed Gordon Bombay #790 Light Green Funko Pop! - BAS
description: Remember Emilio Estevez's iconic role as coach Gordon Bambay in The Mighty Ducks by making this signed Funko Pop! part of your collection. In this first installment of The Mighty Ducks film series, Bombay is a successful attorney in Minneapolis who is arrested for DUI, and his sentence would be 500 hours of community service by coaching the Mighty Ducks, a local Pee-Wee hockey team. Growing up, Bombay was a star player for the Ducks' rival team, the Hawks, and this coaching job would be his first experience with the sport since he missed what would have been the championship-winning penalty shot when he was a kid. Bombay quickly learns that the Ducks are not set up for success, but his expertise with the sport allowed him to teach them the fundamentals of the game. The Ducks would enjoy success and would be slated to face Bombay's childhood team in the championship game. With the coach's inspirational words to Charlie, the star player on the Ducks, they would win the game after Charlie did a ''triple-deke'' move that faked out the Hawks' goalie to score the game-winning goal. Your unwavering fandom of Estevez's legendary role in this 1992 sports comedy-drama film will be on full display with this signed vinyl figure.

name: Men's Nike Bobby Witt Jr. White Kansas City Royals 2026 City Connect Stadium Jersey
description: Rooted in the beauty of Kansas City's iconic fountains, this jersey reflects the city's place at the heart of the nation. The first thing you'll notice is the consistent color gradient across each graphic, inspired by the City of Fountains logo adopted by Kansas City in 1991. That identity carries into Kauffman Stadium, where the iconic fountains beyond the center field wall reinforce the city's connection to water. The Royals' R logo on the chest echoes their original 1969 design, blending the roots of the past with a fresh, modern look. The heart logo on the sleeve reflects Kansas City's role as the nation's heartland. The "Hey Hey Hey Hey" graphic on the interior collar nods to Kansas City/Hey-Hey-Hey-Hey!, famously performed by The Beatles at Municipal Stadium in 1964, adding a final layer of local history and pride.

name: Men's Nike Corey Seager Red Texas Rangers 2026 City Connect Stadium Jersey
description: Rooted in heritage and tradition, this jersey honors the cultural influences that define Texas. This jersey features a "Tejas" wordmark across the chest, honoring the Mexican influence in the state and the Caddo word meaning "friend," from which the name Texas is derived. The wordmark style is inspired by the Rangers' uniforms from the '80s, connecting the past with the present. The red base of the jersey is reimagined with Cochineal red, a sacred crimson dye derived from the cochineal insect that is historically and symbolically significant in Mexican culture. The block "T" on the cap traces back to the logo used when the team debuted in 1972. On the sleeve, a Texas state outline appears in papel picado, the traditional Mexican folk art known for its intricate, hand-cut designs, adding a vibrant and meaningful finishing touch.

name: Tyrese Haliburton Indiana Pacers Autographed 16" x 20" Eastern Conference Finals Game 1 vs. New York Knicks Game-Tying Shot Photograph
description: Tyrese Haliburton's star status has continued to grow throughout the 2025 NBA Playoffs. He's led the Indiana Pacers to the Eastern Conference Finals for the second straight season and proven time and time again to be one of the league's premier clutch performers. No night proved this more than Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals against the New York Knicks on May 21. Haliburton's heroics capped off a miraculous comeback effort, with Indiana trailing by as many as 17 points in the fourth quarter. After dribbling into the paint during regulation's final possession, he pulled back toward the 3-point arc. With Haliburton's toe just on the line, his buzzer-beating shot bounced straight up the back iron before falling through the net to tie the game at 125 and force overtime. The Pacers took care of business in the extra period, stunning a once-rowdy crowd inside Madison Square Garden and claiming a 1-0 series lead. Commemorate the already iconic shot with this incredible 16" x 20" photograph that has been autographed by Haliburton. No matter where you display this bold image, it's sure to keep the celebration of Indiana's crazy game one victory going for years to come. Additionally, it includes an individually numbered, tamper-evident hologram that can be verified online to certify its authenticity.

name: Tyrese Haliburton Indiana Pacers Autographed 8" x 10" Eastern Conference Finals Game 1 vs. New York Knicks Game-Tying Shot Photograph
description: Tyrese Haliburton's star status has continued to grow throughout the 2025 NBA Playoffs. He's led the Indiana Pacers to the Eastern Conference Finals for the second straight season and proven time and time again to be one of the league's premier clutch performers. No night proved this more than Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Finals against the New York Knicks on May 21. Haliburton's heroics capped off a miraculous comeback effort, with Indiana trailing by as many as 17 points in the fourth quarter. After dribbling into the paint during regulation's final possession, he pulled back toward the 3-point arc. With Haliburton's toe just on the line, his buzzer-beating shot bounced straight up the back iron before falling through the net to tie the game at 125 and force overtime. The Pacers took care of business in the extra period, stunning a once-rowdy crowd inside Madison Square Garden and claiming a 1-0 series lead. Commemorate the already iconic shot with this incredible 8" x 10" photograph that has been autographed by Haliburton. description: "Hail to Pitt!" Traditions are born from winning, and the University of Pittsburgh Panthers football program had the blueprint early. At Pitt, the traditions run deep.
